# form parses the request body through request.ParseForm, so binding form and
# body in the same call would read the single-use stream twice.

cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
	"net/url"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) Save(_ context.Context, _ url.Values, _ io.Reader) (string, error) { return "", nil }
